chunks: And with this chain of narrators, from Muhammad ibn Uthman, he said: Narrated to us Ibn Awad from Al-Sha'bi from Jabir ibn Samra, who said:

It was mentioned that the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) said: 'The people of this religion will continue to be victorious over those who oppose them until there are twelve Caliphs.' People were standing and sitting (in restlessness), and he spoke a word that I did not understand, so I asked my father - or my brother: 'What did he say?' He replied: 'He said: All of them are from Quraish.'
ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet say about the number and lineage of the twelve Caliphs?
ai.summary: Recorded by Shaykh al-Tusi in *Kitab al-Ghayba* to validate the twelve Imams through Ahl al-Sunnah sources, this hadith establishes that the twelve leaders will be exclusively from the Quraysh, a criterion Shia scholars use to identify the specific Imams from the Prophet's progeny. The narration underscores the divine guarantee of victory for the community as long as these twelve designated leaders guide them, linking political authority to spiritual continuity.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 92 - It is narrated from the same chains of narrators from Muhammad bin Uthman that: Narrated to us Ibn Awad from Shobi from Jabir bin Samra that he said:

The Holy Prophet (s) remarked: The people of this religion would be helped against one who intends harm to them till the tenure of the twelve Caliphs. [When the Prophet said this] People were coming and going and there was a lot of disturbance; at that time the Holy Prophet (s) mentioned some words, which I could not understand. So I asked my father or brother: What did the Prophet say? He replied: He said: All of them would be from Quraish.
